<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="planning-summary" name="Planning Visual Summary"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1180" pageHeight="620" math="0" shadow="0" adaptiveColors="auto"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=24;fontColor=#18343B;fontStyle=1;" value="Planning: discover the how
Conceptual execution loop; the console's plan-write variant demonstrates outline + summary only." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="1100" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="goalInput" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontSize=16;" value="Goal + constraints
current state" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="160" x="40" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="planner" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#18343B;fontColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#18343B;fontSize=16;" value="Planner
bounded ordered steps" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="170" x="250" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="gather" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF0E8;strokeColor=#D99B76;fontSize=16;" value="1. Gather
sources / observations" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="170" x="480" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="analyze" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E9EDF7;strokeColor=#9AA8C2;fontSize=16;" value="2. Analyze
compare evidence" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="160" x="720" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="synthesize" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontSize=16;" value="3. Synthesize
draft findings" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="160" x="960" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="check" parent="1" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF0E8;strokeColor=#D99B76;fontSize=16;" value="Goal met?
Budget remains?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="180" x="710" y="340" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="goalMet" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontSize=16;" value="Completed
return evidence + result" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="180" x="960" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="incomplete" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FCE8E7;strokeColor=#D58C86;fontSize=16;" value="Incomplete
report gaps / stop" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="180" x="480" y="480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="goalInput" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;" target="planner"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="planner" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;" target="gather"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="gather" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;" target="analyze"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="analyze" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;" target="synthesize"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="synthesize" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" target="check"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1040" y="300" /> <mxPoint x="800" y="300" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="check" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="goalMet" value="Yes"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="check" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="planner" value="No: replan while budget remains"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e8" edge="1" parent="1" source="check" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="incomplete" value="No + exhausted"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
